title: Senior Product Manager
jobDescription: Property Guru is Southeast Asia’s leading Prop Tech company, and the preferred destination for over 32 million property seekers monthly to connect with over 50,000 agents monthly to find their dream home. Property Guru empowers property seekers with more than 2.1 million real estate listings, in-depth insights, and solutions that enable them to make confident property decisions across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam. Property Guru.com.sg was launched in Singapore in 2007 and since then, Property Guru Group has made the property journey a transparent one for property seekers in Southeast Asia. In the last 18 years, Property Guru has grown into a high-growth Prop Tech company with a robust portfolio including leading property marketplaces and award-winning mobile apps across its markets in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand as well as the region’s biggest and most respected industry recognition platform – Property Guru Asia Property Awards, events and publications across Asia. For more information, please visit: Property Guru Group.com; Property Guru Group on Linked In. Recognised as a Top Employers Certified* organisation, we’re proud to be among the best workplaces in the region—celebrating an inclusive culture of excellence, growth, and well-being. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team and play a critical leadership role in shaping how our marketplace creates value for everyone it serves. Property Guru sits at the heart of a two-sided marketplace, connecting property seekers with the agents and partners who serve them. In this role, you will own problems that span both sides of the marketplace: balancing supply and demand, improving liquidity and match quality, and building products and services that create value for consumers and agents alike. This role will entail partnering closely with engineering teams, product and program managers, user experience designers, marketing managers, and customer service leaders. You will also shape the vision of Property Guru in becoming a trusted advisor to every person seeking property across Southeast Asia. Responsibilities Lead the definition, execution, and roll-out of features, both customer-facing and those that support business operations or improve development efficiency. Drive speed on ideation, planning, design, and development of new products Ability to break down complex problems into actionable steps Partner with functions, including engineering, program management, marketing, and sales to produce the best quality products & services as a team. Collaborate with and learn from partners and vendors with cutting-edge solutions Learn from customer feedback, behavioral measurements, A/B tests, and other data sources to build better experiences and ensure we build the right things over time. Motivate teams by developing and constantly sharing a compelling vision for the product, driven by customer and marketplace insights and data Provide mentorship and best practices to the broader Product Management organization. Define value propositions that create wins for both sides of the marketplace. Ruthlessly prioritize and align stakeholders as new priorities emerge Requirements 5+ years crafting and delivering world-class products Experience building marketplace or platform products preferred, with a strong grasp of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including liquidity, matching, network effects, and monetization Ability to set long-term strategy, bring structure to ambiguity, and break big goals into concrete, achievable steps. Ability to prioritize requirements across conflicting priorities Strong analytical and quantitative skills, using data and metrics (A/B tests, experiments, user testing) to back assumptions, form recommendations, and drive action Fluent with AI tools: you use them daily for research, analysis, prototyping, and writing, and you have an opinion on Claude Code vs. Codex (we’d love to hear it) Engineers, designers, and cross-functional partners love working with you Display good empathy, judgment, leadership & focus. Bias to action: you do what it takes to get quality products to market on time Our commitment to you: Hybrid flexible working that focuses on outcomes over hours. Holistic rewards package covering your financial, physical & mental health. Multi-directional career development across all levels. Inclusive benefits like equal paternity leave, supporting all employees in work-life balance. At Property Guru, you’ll be part of a Top Employers Certified* company that puts people at the heart of everything we do. Joining Property Guru Group means more than just a new job. It’s an opportunity to shape the future of an entire industry and the lives of millions in Southeast Asia. We’re the leading Prop Tech company in Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand. We leverage data and technology to create trust and transparency in the real estate industry with our market-leading property marketplaces, mortgage guidance for life’s biggest financial decisions and data insights that help our partners unlock hidden business potential. Our platforms, solutions and expertise guide property seekers, agents and developers to make confident decisions at every step of the property journey. Innovation with impact As a Guru, you’ll be at the forefront of Prop Tech innovation, harnessing AI and technology to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Your work will create solutions that transform urban landscapes and power communities across the region. Being a Guru means guiding millions towards their property dreams while continuously evolving yourself. As we enhance our offerings to serve Southeast Asia’s diverse markets, you’ll grow too by learning from industry pioneers and charting your own path. Your unique perspective, joining our team of 1,300 Gurus from 30+ nationalities, could spark our next breakthrough. Beyond the bottom line Our people are our biggest strength and we take pride in our Gurus First approach in the way we conduct business. We offer hybrid, flexible working arrangements, competitive salaries, progressive, comprehensive benefits, and foster a collaborative, inclusive, and open team culture. In turn, our Gurus are driven by a purpose that goes beyond the bottom line. We’re committed to making sustainable, accessible living a reality for all. As part of our team, you’ll be working towards our vision: We power communities to live, work, and thrive in tomorrow’s cities. Your journey as a Guru starts here. Ready to open doors to new possibilities? Learn more about the company: Property Guru Group

About the Role We are looking for a Workplace IT Specialist to help transform how technology is delivered to employees across Property Guru’s regional offices — moving us from traditional, ticket-driven IT support to a modern, automated, engineering-led workplace. This is a builder’s role. You will design and ship automation that eliminates manual work — one-touch onboarding and offboarding, zero-touch device provisioning, self-service access — while providing deep (Level 2/3) technical expertise across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and our endpoint fleet. You will treat IT operations as an engineering discipline: solutions are scripted, version-controlled in Git, peer-reviewed, and documented — not clicked together in portals. The ideal candidate has already led or contributed to a transformation from traditional ITSM to modern workplace engineering, and can show working automation they have built to prove it. What You Will Do Automation & Workplace Engineering (primary focus) Build one-touch employee lifecycle automation: end-to-end onboarding and offboarding workflows (HR trigger → identity → licensing → groups → device → apps → access revocation) so new joiners are productive on day one and leavers are cleanly deprovisioned. Engineer zero-touch device provisioning with Windows Autopilot and Intune (and mac OS equivalents), replacing manual imaging and setup. Automate routine IT operations using Power Shell, Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and REST APIs — license management, security group management, compliance reporting, fleet health monitoring, and access reviews. Apply software engineering practices to IT: version control in Git, code review, testing, and repeatable/idempotent scripts; move configuration toward configuration-as-code where practical. Build self-service and shift-left capabilities (app catalogs, automated access requests, chat-based helpers) that deflect tickets and reduce dependence on manual support. Identify and eliminate toil: continuously find manual, repetitive processes and engineer them away, measuring the hours saved. Microsoft 365 & Identity Engineering Administer and improve Microsoft 365 services: Exchange Online, Teams, Share Point Online, One Drive, Intune, and Entra ID. Own identity lifecycle automation in Entra ID: dynamic groups, entitlement management, access packages, SCIM provisioning, SSO/enterprise application integrations. Design and maintain Conditional Access, MFA, and identity security policies aligned with Zero Trust and least-privilege principles. Administer Azure resources supporting workplace services (e.g., Automation Accounts, Logic Apps, Azure Functions used for IT automation). Endpoint & Device Management Manage the Windows and mac OS fleet with Microsoft Intune / MDM: security baselines, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment. Run patch management and vulnerability remediation programmatically (Windows Update for Business / Autopatch, Defender recommendations). Drive Windows 11 upgrades, hardware refresh, and device lifecycle management with automated, data-driven processes. Build endpoint monitoring and fleet health dashboards to shift IT from reactive tickets to proactive remediation. Advanced Support & Operations Provide Level 2/3 escalation support for complex issues across Windows, mac OS, Microsoft 365, networking, meeting room technology, and enterprise applications — with a bias toward permanent, engineered fixes over repeat workarounds. Support regional offices onsite and remotely; participate in on-call and major incident response when required. Meet SLAs while driving down ticket volume through root-cause elimination and automation. Support collaboration and AV platforms: Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Logitech Rally; assist with networking fundamentals (VPN, Wi-Fi, switching, DNS/DHCP, firewall). Security & Compliance Maintain endpoint and identity compliance aligned with ISO 27001; support audits and security reviews with automated evidence collection and reporting. Implement least-privilege access (RBAC, PIM) and endpoint security controls; act on Microsoft Defender and Secure Score recommendations. Documentation, Projects & Mentoring Document as an engineer: runbooks, architecture diagrams, SOPs, and knowledge base articles kept alongside code in Git. Deliver regional IT projects: office builds and relocations, M365 migrations, endpoint modernization, meeting room deployments, and automation initiatives. Mentor junior engineers in scripting, automation, and modern workplace practices; raise the engineering bar across the team. What You Bring Required 2–5 years in IT engineering, end-user computing, modern workplace, or IT infrastructure roles, with strong hands-on depth. An engineering mindset: you default to automating problems away rather than resolving them manually, and can show automation you have personally built and shipped. Strong Power Shell and Microsoft Graph API skills — able to build production-quality automation, not just run one-off scripts. Hands-on administration of Microsoft Entra ID and Azure: identity lifecycle, Conditional Access, enterprise apps/SSO, RBAC, and Azure services used for automation. Deep Microsoft 365 administration experience (Exchange Online, Teams, Share Point, One Drive, Intune) in an enterprise environment. Modern endpoint management expertise: Intune, Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging across Windows 10/11 and mac OS. Experience with Active Directory and Group Policy, including hybrid identity environments. Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, switching). Excellent communication and customer empathy; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Strongly Preferred A track record of transforming traditional ITSM into modern workplace engineering — e.g., you have implemented one-touch onboarding/offboarding, zero-touch provisioning, or replaced manual runbooks with automated workflows. Git and modern development workflow experience: version-controlled scripts and configurations, pull requests / code review, and ideally CI/CD pipelines (Git Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops) for IT automation. Configuration-as-code / infrastructure-as-code exposure (e.g., Terraform or Microsoft365DSC for Intune and Entra ID configuration). Power Platform experience (Power Automate, Power Apps) with an understanding of governance and when low-code vs. pro-code is appropriate. Python or another general-purpose scripting language; comfort working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks. Experience using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to accelerate scripting, documentation, and support workflows — and helping roll such tooling out to employees. Experience with virtualization platforms and cloud services beyond M365. Certifications (advantageous, not required) Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102), or Microsoft Applied Skills (Intune, Entra ID, Automation). ITIL Foundation, Comp TIA Network+/Security+, Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals. What Success Looks Like Within 12 months, employee onboarding and offboarding run as one-touch automated workflows with measurable reductions in provisioning time and manual errors. Device provisioning is zero-touch; a new laptop reaches a productive, compliant state without engineer hands-on time. Recurring incident categories are engineered away, reducing ticket volume while SLA performance and employee satisfaction improve. IT automation lives in version-controlled repositories with documentation, and junior engineers are contributing to it. Endpoint compliance, patch currency, and Secure Score measurably improve, with automated reporting supporting ISO 27001 audits. You are the trusted technical advisor for modern workplace decisions and a multiplier for the wider team. Personal Attributes Builder’s mentality with strong ownership — you see a manual process and itch to automate it. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; rigorous about root cause. Continuous learner with genuine curiosity for new technology, including AI-assisted ways of working. Self-motivated, well organized, and able to prioritize in a fast-paced regional environment. Collaborative team player who lifts others through mentoring and knowledge sharing. Our commitment to you: Hybrid flexible working that focuses on outcomes over hours. Holistic rewards package covering your financial, physical & mental health. Multi-directional career development across all levels. ROLE:
This is a senior leadership role on the People & Culture Leadership Team (PLT). The Head of People – Country and function Lead (CTPO) is the single point of accountability for the full end to end people agenda across their country and/or functional remit. Direct reporting line is to the Head of HR People & Culture, with a dotted line to the Country Managing Director or relevant XLT business leader. Why This Role Exists Now Property Guru is in an era of deliberate reinvention under PG Next: country-led operating model, matrix ways of working, and AI-accelerating change in both what we ask of our workforce and how P&C itself delivers. People Leadership Team (PLT) Membership As a member of the PLT, this role carries collective ownership of the P&C function's performance, culture, and transformation alongside the Head of P&C and peer PLT members. PLT members are expected to: Contribute to and own elements of the P&C operating model Operate with full accountability Shared ways of working, and cross-functional collaboration are a collective responsibility Model the leadership behaviours the business expects from its own people leaders: psychological safety, honest feedback, recognition, and deliberate development of their teams Engage constructively in functional talent reviews and hold a view on talent across the P&C function, not only their own team Bring an enterprise lens to decisions, balancing country or functional needs against what is right for P&C and Property Guru as a whole P&C Operating Model This role has explicit ownership, alongside the CPO and PLT, for shaping and executing the P&C function's operating model focused on AI-infused, human-prioritised P&C function (where transactional work is automated, process value is redesigned, and P&C professionals spend strategic partnering including but not limited to org design, talent strategy, management and development, leadership coaching, and workforce capability). Org Design, Workforce Planning & the Future of Work This role is the primary HR partner on org design and workforce transformation for their business unit(s). Org Design Design and implement effective country or functional org structures that reflect business strategy, the matrix ways of working model, and the realities of AI-driven role evolution Identify where current structures create friction, slow execution, or concentrate risk and propose clear, data-supported redesigns Embed change management rigorously: org changes without effective change management produce attrition, not efficiency Workforce Planning Lead structured workforce planning conversations with business leaders (headcount management, capability forecasting: what skills do we need, in what timeframe, and via what strategy (build/buy/borrow/bot)), data focused Drive FTE forecast accuracy and manage within budget, working in close partnership with Finance HRBPs Proactive Talent Management Codesign, and lead talent management and talent review cadence, driving clear outcomes aligned to impact for the business, partnering with business leaders to actively manage talent (developing Talent and managing low performance proactively) Protect high performers and top talent with visible, differentiated focus (development, recognition, and stretch opportunities) Leadership of Local P&C Teams This role manages the local P&C team directly (HRBPs, People Services, and Talent Acquisition) and is fully accountable for the engagement, capability, and performance of that team and all local P&C members including matrix reportees. Active people leadership
